lines.en: The ground shakes with my steps.

lines.zh: 我踩过的草全倒向一边。
lines.en: Grass bends flat where I have trodden.
My belly is empty again.
This hide is harder than stone.
I smell meat moving.
One of my steps is three of yours.
Tree in the way? Push it down.
My shadow covers the whole path.
The bone plates at my waist rattle.
Do not walk behind me.
My steps are heavy, but never resting.
Mud becomes a pit under my feet.
When hungry, the road feels short.
There is smoke from the village ahead.

lines.zh: 我撞开灌木，枝条断在身后。
lines.en: I crash through the brush, branches breaking behind me.

lines.zh: 我一步跨过水沟，泥溅到肩上。
lines.en: One stride clears the ditch and mud hits my shoulder.
I am chewing a bone.
The last meal still lingers in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙能塞下一个人。
lines.en: A man would fit down my throat.
Who is tapping my teeth?
My stomach growls louder than thunder.
This well is too narrow.
I crumbled the stone to powder.
The fungus on my back keeps growing.
I lost count of how many I ate.
It is hot; the inside of my hide itches.
I lick the blood off my hand.
Who left a blade in my back?
I do not sleep; sleeping makes me hungrier.
Something living has passed here.

lines.zh: 我把骨渣从牙缝里抠出来
lines.en: I pick bone splinters out from between my teeth.
The mycelium on my chest twitches.
You are too small for a meal.
Stand back; looking up tires me.
Your knees shake. That cannot be hidden.
You smell of iron.
Look up; let me see you.
Your head barely reaches my knee.
You run faster than the last one.
Do not hide by my feet.
You are hunting for a direction to run.

lines.zh: 你的站位已经画在我脑里。
lines.en: Your position is drawn inside my head.
Do you see my mouth opening?

lines.zh: 我等你的脚自己挪过来。
lines.en: I wait for your feet to bring you.
That was a mosquito bite.
Thick hide does not stop the pain.
Someone cut into my shoulder.
Blood wells out between the plates.
I swayed once, but did not fall.
My bones ring dull under the blow.
Now you have made me angry.
This barely counts as a wound.
Your scent is stuck between my teeth.
A tooth is loose. Annoying.
Give me the meat in your hand.
That smell would fill a gap in my teeth.
A cow for your life.
I am not picky; cooked or raw.
Put it down. Slowly.
You are carrying bread too, are you not?
I smell meat in your pack.
Give it all and I walk away.
Feed me and I will not eat you.
This smell reminds me of sheep.
Do not run; the meat will fall.
One bite and I leave. Truly.
Keeping some for yourself is pointless.
It smells so good I sway.

lines.zh: 你肩上那袋肉，晃得我心慌。
lines.en: That bag of meat on your shoulder makes me restless.
I'm reaching out, so don't run yet.

lines.zh: 你撞我一下，弹回去老远。
lines.en: You hit me once and bounce far back.
I nearly stepped on you.
Do not walk against my legs.
You actually made me sway.
Your armor poked me.
Get clear; I cannot stop my feet.
I heard your bones creak.
This hide does not mind a collision.
Two steps back; do not press my belly.
You are standing in my footprint.
You are shorter, but solid.
Let us eat this wood empty together.
Guard the cave mouth; I move the stones.
I will share half a boar with you.
With the two of us, none dare.
Your hands are even thicker than mine.
I know your smell.
Do not take the piece in my mouth.
Sleep; I listen to the wind.
We take the same road.
Is this rock worth throwing?
I pick up a small tree.
Is the shiny thing edible?
I stuff it into my hide belt.
This bone will make a toothpick.
Leave it; that is my rock.
I lift the whole chest.
Too small; not worth the reach.
I found a tiny shield.
This will block wind at the cave.
You are exactly one mouthful.
Do not run; I chase slowly.
I am hungry. You will do.
Your sweat drifts over on the wind.
You are standing close enough.
I am going to put you in my mouth.
The slowest one goes first.
You have a weapon. Better.
There is only you here.
Turning will not escape this hand.
I open my mouth and measure.
You have shrunk against the crevice.
Closer, so I can lower my head.
I wait for your feet to pause.
The wind brings your scent.
You are panting too hard.
I bend slowly, so you are not startled.
One hand is enough to catch you.
Under my shadow there is no way out.
Now. Do not move.
One punch leaves a crater.
I lift you toward my mouth.
You cannot wriggle free between my teeth.
This mouthful will take a while to chew.
My fist is bigger than a door.
You are in my mouth; dismount now.
Bones crack between my teeth.
Bare hands are enough to take you apart.
Your hit loosened a tooth.
With something in my mouth, I never open.

lines.zh: 这身肉是从小长起来的。
lines.en: This bulk grew from something small.
I push myself out of the spore heap.
How tall I have become.
Is there a village nearby?
My first breath stinks.
Broken mushroom caps litter my feet.
I am hungry. Hungry already.
I stand; my head meets the branches.
Who is talking over there?
First, find something to eat.
The fungus on my hide crackles and burns.
I hit the ground and leave a deep pit.
Water pours into my mouth. Cold.
After the blast my ears still drum.
An arrow sticks in my back.
This light numbs my head.
An empty belly greys my sight.
Lightning struck me; my hide is scorched.
No ground here, and no meat.
